notes.title: Release Candidate
notes.notes:
[b]New Features: [/b]
[list]
[*] Multiple camera angles that can be switched during gameplay
[*] Key rebinding options
[*] Display options including screen resolution, global quality, refresh rate and windowed mode
[*] Translations for English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, German, Russian, French, Italian, Spanish
[*] Mission list to view in game objectives
[*] Steam achievements 
[*] Global and Local leaderboard system
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37311652/9f1217766e3fc37560940f47410e1034b1036673.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Bug Fix Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Improved music, fixed the volume bug
[*] Added more tunes
[*] Fixed the nudge/tilt, now has a 1 second gap between uses
[*] Fixed the ball getting stuck on Vegas
[*] Ability to control music and sfx volumes
[/list]

notes.title: Portrait Mode Support
notes.notes:
We haven't implemented some of the options in the list yet but will soon.  The main resolution changing stuff does work however.
I managed to get portrait support but only the Zen Garden currently works. Need to think about some kind of camera control

notes.title: Pinball Lockdown in Early Access
notes.notes:
We are releasing Pinball Lockdown in Early Access complete with 5 full tables.

More are on the way, post any ideas on the discussion.

We won't be doing what the other pinball games do and hiding away our tables somewhere where you have to pay extra.  What you seen is what you get.

Have a great time and stay safe.
